newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-UIH Int'l says still plans raising.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-UIH Int'l says still plans raising.

text.p: United International Holdings Inc (UIH) said on Tuesday it still planned to go ahead with a capital raising later this year, despite shelving plans last month for a US$100 million public offer of class A common stock.
"I think we shall have to wait a bit longer for that," said Donald Hagans, executive chairman of Austar, a unit of UIH.
Hagans told reporters after giving a speech at the Australasian Cable and Satellite Television conference here that there was no set plan for the proposed capital raising.
UIH's unit UIH Asia/Pacific Communications Inc (UAP) was the vehicle for the capital raising.
Austar is the major arm of UAP's operations and has access to 1.6 million homes in regional Australia. UAP also has operations in New Zealand, the Philippines and French Polynesia.

Hagans said he had no comment on any speculation that Austar would make a bid for fellow satellite television operator East Coast Television (ECT), which has been put up for sale by its parent Century Communications Inc.
However, Hagans admitted a purchase of ECT would be a "logical" move for Austar. Both Austar and ECT are regional franchisees of Australis Media Ltd.
Hagans said in his speech to the conference that there needs to be rationalisation in Australia's pay television industry.
